look: Cinematic Hollywood blockbuster, ARRI Alexa 65, anamorphic 2.39:1, teal-and-orange grade with electric-blue tech light, deep contrast, torrential driving rain, dramatic lightning, wet reflective surfaces, volumetric haze, anamorphic lens flares, 120fps slow-motion accents, film grain, IMAX quality, photoreal, hyper-detailed.

scenes.name: c00_hook
scenes.prompt: Macro ultra slow-motion: a single rain droplet strikes a glowing exam answer-sheet and explodes into a shockwave of electric-blue light; whip smash-cut to an extreme close-up of a determined young professional's eyes snapping open behind wet aviator sunglasses, lightning reflected in the lenses. Audio: silence, then wind, then a thunder crack and bass drop on the eye-open.

scenes.name: c01_entrance
scenes.prompt: Worm's-eye low angle in pouring rain: a confident young professional steps out onto a rain-soaked neon street; a brilliant electric-blue ring of light ignites around them and the whole futuristic city powers on in a wave as lightning strikes behind; slow push to the calm, ready face. Audio: rising braam, heartbeat, thunder boom.

scenes.name: c02_reveal
scenes.prompt: A professional removes wet aviator sunglasses in slow motion; behind them a colossal electric-blue holographic study platform erupts through the rain, floating dashboards, glowing question cards and progress rings, god-rays and lightning arcing into it. Audio: deep thunder roll and rising strings.

scenes.name: c03_eleven
scenes.prompt: Epic wide shot, crane pulling back: eleven glowing certification badges ignite in a constellation around the hero in the storm, abstract luminous blue emblems floating in the rain, three lightning bolts striking in rhythm, immense scale. Audio: orchestral swell with taiko hits on each bolt.

scenes.name: c04_judges
scenes.prompt: Four colossal glowing holographic gates tower in the storm, each a radiant seal of light; a single bright question card flies forward and passes through all four gates in sequence, each gate stamping a glowing green checkmark on it, lightning flashing on each stamp. Cinematic tracking push through the gates. Audio: four rising impacts, thunder on the fourth.

scenes.name: c05_accuracy
scenes.prompt: Close-up in the rain: a glowing question card under a focused blue beam; a holographic checkmark verifies it, then it snaps onto a luminous grid blueprint, both flashing green seals of approval, precise and high-tech. Audio: precise ticks and low thunder.

scenes.name: c06_relevance
scenes.prompt: A glowing question card is weighed against a luminous silhouette, then stress-tested on a rising holographic difficulty dial that climbs to maximum, green seals stamping, electric-blue light, storm around it. Audio: tension riser and impact.

scenes.name: c07_coach
scenes.prompt: A warm electric-blue AI presence of light materializes beside the hero in the rain like a glowing coach, a personalized path of light lighting up through the storm pointing the way. Camera orbits the pair. Audio: ethereal tones rising over thunder.

scenes.name: c08_peers
scenes.prompt: Pull back to reveal dozens of glowing human figures across a stormy neon city connected by threads of electric-blue light, a living supportive network moving together, epic scale. Audio: warm swell and driving pulse.

scenes.name: c09_arena
scenes.prompt: Hyperspeed first-person rush through a glowing exam arena in the storm, holographic timed question cards streaking past, a confident hero answering with precision, intense motion blur, electric-blue light. Audio: rapid risers and electric crackle.

scenes.name: c10_pass
scenes.prompt: A giant holographic progress ring fills with electric-blue light and flips to a glowing green PASS seal; the hero exhales triumphantly in the backlit rain, god-rays bursting. Audio: building tension toward a drop.

scenes.name: c11_global
scenes.prompt: Dramatic pull-back to a glowing holographic planet Earth spinning in the storm, electric-blue threads of light connecting triumphant figures in cities worldwide. Audio: full orchestra and choir rising.

scenes.name: c12_champion
scenes.prompt: Epic low-angle hero shot, slow crane up: a radiant electric-blue ring emblem rises to the center of frame like a champion's trophy; a massive lightning bolt strikes it and it blazes with brilliant blue-white light, god-rays bursting and embers raining, a vast cheering crowd and storm skyline below, a triumphant hero beneath it, rain backlit. IMAX scale, victorious, goosebumps. Audio: the biggest drop, full orchestra, choir, taiko and a thunder boom with a roaring crowd.

scenes.name: c13_companion
scenes.prompt: Intimate close-up as the rain softens, warm electric-blue light: a gentle glowing AI companion and soft threads of peer light stay beside the hero like loyal allies, emotional and cinematic. Audio: tender solo piano with gentle rain.

scenes.name: c14_future
scenes.prompt: The storm breaks: a now-successful hero stands at the edge of a breathtaking futuristic city as a golden sunrise pierces the clouds, a glowing certificate of light in hand, horizon opening, hopeful and vast. Audio: a hopeful orchestral swell rebuilding.

scenes.name: c15_tocamera
scenes.prompt: Slow push-in: a confident hero looks directly into the lens with a warm smile, water on the face, glowing city bokeh and a last flash of lightning behind, photoreal. Audio: intimate, then building.

scenes.name: c16_cta
scenes.prompt: A hero gives a confident nod as a glowing electric-blue call-to-action button and a notification bell ignite beside them in the rain, a clean premium banner of light below. Audio: a sparkle, a bell chime and a bass stinger.

scenes.name: c17_title
scenes.prompt: A radiant electric-blue ring emblem ignites in a burst of embers and anamorphic lens flares with a flash of lightning over a dark stormy cinematic background, then settles into a clean premium title lockup of glowing light. Audio: a final epic orchestral hit, a thunder crack and a resolving chord.
